notes.title: 🖤 Thank you, bastards. You made this possible. 🖤
notes.content: [h3][b]Lucky Bastard[/b] has been released. [/h3][p]It's been a long road, considering that this is my first project.[/p][p]No producers, no team, no marketers. I did it alone, using my experience and my vision of what an adult visual novel should be.[/p][h3][b]But none of it would have meant anything without you.[/b][/h3][p]You played, supported, criticized, praised, shared your impressions, and helped us move forward.[/p][p]If you enjoyed [b]Lucky Bastard[/b], [b]please leave a positive review on Steam.[/b][/p][p]For a solo developer, it's not just “nice” — it literally saves the game from oblivion.[/p][p]Every review helps the project avoid getting lost in the algorithms and gives it a chance to continue.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FvQt17S.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This isn't the end. There will be a sequel to the story of Lisa and Olga. There will also be a separate story about Margo.[/p][p]🎭 And if you want to discuss scenes, girls, or just vent, check out the discussions and our Discord.[/p][p][b]Thank you for being with me.[/b][/p][p]Stay lucky, –  dev[/p]

notes.title: Final release
notes.content: [h3]Hello, friends. [/h3][p]I present to you the finale of the story about the Lucky Bastard. I have put a lot of effort and time into this project. Let me remind you that I am doing this alone and only thanks to your support.[/p][p]Enjoy the game.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FvdENzG.jpg"][/img]I would like to note that the game will still be refined. A gallery with 2K renders will be added. The music will be changed and some scenes and dialogues will be voiced.[/p]

notes.title: The final version will be available tomorrow.
notes.content: [h3]                                            Hello everyone! [/h3][p]I would like to announce that the final release of the story will take place tomorrow. Thank you to [/p][p]everyone who supported us, wrote reviews, and simply played and waited. I'll say right away that I'm [/p][p]planning at least one addition to the story. You'll understand what it's about when you finish the game.[/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FkwV6Tg.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks again, without your support it would have been difficult for me to get to the end of this journey.[/p][p] You guys are the best[/p][p]-Dev.[/p]

notes.title: 💬 Your Review Makes a Difference
notes.content: [h3]Hi to all players of Lucky Bastard[/h3][p][/p][p]I'm the solo developer behind this game, and I’m reaching out directly to ask for your support.[/p][p]If you enjoyed the story, characters, atmosphere, or the scenes — please consider leaving a positive [/p][p]review on the store page. It takes less than a minute, and it truly helps.[/p][p][/p][h3]💬 Why does it matter?[/h3][p]Steam heavily relies on user reviews to decide which games to show to others.[/p][p]Right now, the game is sitting at around 75%, and every positive review really makes a difference in [/p][p]getting the game seen.[/p][p][u]Your words[/u] — even just a simple “I liked it” — can change the visibility of this project for other potential [/p][p]players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://iili.io/FY4WwJt.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]❤️ Reviews are not just numbers[/h3][p]For me, as a solo indie developer, reviews are the lifeline. This isn’t a corporate project — it’s personal, [/p][p]built with passion, experience, and honesty.[/p][p][/p][p]If Lucky Bastard meant something to you, please leave a trace. It helps more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Thank you for your time. And your review.[/u][/p][p]Stay lucky, –  dev[/p]

notes.title: Early access release. What's next?
notes.content:
Lucky bastard was released on the 24th. During this time was collected a certain amount of feedback, which was studied . And in connection with this, I would like to tell you about the upcoming changes:

• Achievements will be added.
• Corrections in the translation of the text.
• The game's walkthrough map will be published so you can explore all the content.

If you notice any bugs in the game please report them in the game center Lucky bastard to solve the problem.

Clerik studio are working hard to bring you new and improved features. Follow our updates to stay up to date with the latest changes and improvements!

P.S. If you are still planning to buy the game, you better hurry up, because the 30% discount associated with the release of the game will soon end.
